verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show any setting that lets an mParticle user opt out of mParticle's own telemetry or usage tracking. The Data Privacy Controls and Consent Filters handle GDPR consent and CCPA data-sale opt-outs for the end users whose data customers send through the CDP. That is an adjacent capability for a different purpose, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
